## Professional Summary

Mohamed Magdy Elshafey is a Backend Developer and co-founder of CodeLine Tech with 2+ years of experience delivering production-grade Laravel APIs. He is currently the sole backend developer at Beyonex IT (Riyadh, Saudi Arabia — remote from Cairo), owning architecture, database design, and API delivery across 7+ products in HR, healthcare, wellness, legal, and recruitment domains.

He specializes in multi-tenant SaaS architecture, RBAC, payment gateway integrations (Paymob, HyperPay, Stripe, Dineropay), WhatsApp Business API, Firebase, bilingual Arabic/English APIs, and automated testing with Pest PHP on GitHub Actions CI. He is currently implementing ZATCA e-invoicing integration.

## Projects

### Darabny — Training Marketplace Platform
Built 460+ REST API endpoints across 5 portals (students, training providers, instructors, universities, admins) on Laravel 13. Implemented Paymob card/wallet payments, Stripe, refunds, provider payouts, QR-verifiable certificates, attendance tracking, Firebase auth & push notifications, and a Scholars subscription module. Maintained 100+ Pest feature test files running on GitHub Actions CI.
Tech: Laravel 13, PHP 8.4, MySQL, Sanctum, Paymob, Stripe, Firebase, Pest

### Bayt-Link — SaaS Property Management System
Designed database architecture for buildings, units, owners, and tenants. Implemented RBAC and transaction-safe financial workflows for rent collection. Developed complaints, online payments, voting, internal chat with Laravel Reverb, notifications, and subscription modules.
Tech: Laravel 12, MySQL, Livewire, Clean Architecture

### Beyonex Workflow — Business Management Platform
Architected a multi-company HR/CRM/project management platform with company/branch-scoped data isolation and RBAC. Built a CRM pipeline (quotations → contracts → invoices → payments), QR attendance, leave approvals, real-time chat with Laravel Reverb, and WhatsApp Business API customer conversations.
Tech: Laravel 12, MySQL, Sanctum, Reverb, WhatsApp Business API, Pest

### Gaia Spa — At-Home Spa Booking Platform
Built a booking engine with therapist schedules, leave management, service areas, and distance-based travel fees. Implemented loyalty features: membership tiers, packages, session credits, gift cards, vouchers, coupons, and referral rewards. Designed a pluggable payment gateway layer (Strategy pattern) with Google/Apple Sign-In and FCM push notifications.
Tech: Laravel 13, MySQL, Sanctum, Firebase, Pest

### Elagy Care — E-Pharmacy & Prescription Platform (In Progress)
Built the backend for a multi-sided e-pharmacy serving patients, doctors, pharmacists, pharmacies, delivery drivers, and admins. Designed an order state machine with automatic routing to nearby pharmacy branches, stock reservation, and drug substitution rules. Integrated HyperPay with refunds and pharmacy settlements. Secured with MFA/OTP, audit trails, consent management, and RBAC.
Tech: Laravel 13, PHP 8.5, MySQL, Sanctum, Firebase, Pest

### Nash Menu — Online Restaurant Menu & Ordering
Bilingual (Arabic/English) online menu and ordering system for Nash Nashville Chicken restaurant, built through CodeLine Tech. Supports delivery, pickup, and dine-in with table QR verification. Orders are also routed via WhatsApp. Admin dashboard manages menu, orders, and restaurant settings (delivery fees, tax, minimum order).
Tech: Laravel, PHP 8.4, RESTful APIs, React, i18n

### Faya ERP — Restaurant ERP System
Modular multi-tenant ERP for restaurants and cafés built with Laravel Modules architecture. Covers inventory management and sales workflows for multiple tenants on a shared database.
Tech: Laravel 12, MySQL, Laravel Modules
